name: Hackaton 2026
description: Join the hackaton, find your challenge, and share findings with verified Möbius participants.

store.tagline: Build together. Share discoveries. Celebrate ideas.
store.description:
Hackaton 2026, organized by ANNT, runs from 28 September to 9 October 2026. Explore three flagship bounties and three open briefs, join teams, and share findings with verified Möbius participants. Rewards include top apps and games, platform contributions, Community MVP, and best meme. Winners remain To Be Announced.

Requires an online Möbius installation and connected identity. Connects to the shared event by default. Comments and counts refresh automatically while open; saved alternate events remain intact.
